statement: On the third pass of cejel #625, the red-first commit 1297f8fa4 said that 30 of 31 new fixtures failed against the old code and that ruff-exit-zero was "excluded already by another rule". That held for an earlier version of the fixture (`ruff check --exit-zero .`, which the step reader refuses because `.` is read as the `source` builtin). The fixture had been changed to `ruff check --exit-zero src` minutes before the commit and was not re-run. Run against the old code, it failed like the other 30, so 31 of 31 were red. Rules: write a result into a commit message, record or handback only after running the check on the input as committed. When you edit a fixture, every claim made about its old form is void until you re-run it. A fixture that something else already excludes makes a mutation run vacuous, so check that each fixture is red for the reason it names.
